category_name: Purposeful worker traces and coercive institutional storytelling

critical_failures.finding: A beige foreground wall covers approximately 60 percent of the frame and most of the scanner arch; the named asset hero cannot be evaluated as a complete object.
critical_failures.repair: Repair the invalid evidence camera, record the correction and establish a new baseline without altering the dock layout.

strengths.finding: Numbered speech request, physical intercom, tethered pen, stamp and tray form a coherent controlled check-in workflow.
Office mug, notebook and angled chair suggest ordinary staff use; the taped DO NOT RELEASE notice and partially concealed covered trolley add ominous implications.
Clustering follows dock functions and circulation remains quiet; random clutter does not dominate.

defects: No opened frame establishes corporate reassurance with a coercive second meaning; most signs straightforwardly identify or restrict.
Clean markings, thresholds, controls, counter and cabinets do not visibly establish prolonged use, specific repair or pressure on the institution.
The office and paperwork arrangement show little interrupted or pressured shift activity.
Evidence storage is largely generic secure cabinetry; one taped note lacks a visible handling counterpart.
The covered trolley reads as repeated dark rounded humps with little visible continuous textile drape; its handling relationship to storage is weak.

repairs.action: Develop one warm reassuring institutional graphic or notice whose close-reading qualification and paired retention or denial form reveal coercion; consolidate existing paperwork.
Add selective procedure-driven threshold, queue, latch and counter wear plus one specific maintained repair or replacement; preserve routes and avoid blanket grime.

Give the hold notice a restrained physical handling counterpart linking storage to the covered load, and improve continuous cloth drape and contact; preserve ambiguity and avoid extra medical apparatus.
Develop the existing desk cluster through one interrupted-shift or handover arrangement and a small purposeful repair or use mark; distinguish completed and pending forms without paper clutter.
Correct the obstructed asset evidence camera and record the new baseline; show the complete scanner silhouette, control interface and worker-route relationship.

limits: No author code, history, prior scores or geometry inspected or changed. Technical, cold-start, layout-preservation and runtime gates are not certified.
